blocks.text: Qudrati taur par paida hone wale particulate matter (PM, hawa mein tairte nanhe zarre) mein zameen ki satah ki dhool, aur pollens, spores aur janwaron ke malbe (debris) jaise biological maddey shamil hain. Volcano (aatish-fishan) phatne se atmosphere mein gases aur particulate matter (PM) ki bohat bari miqdar aa sakti hai. Aasmani bijli (thunderbolt) nitrogen ke oxides (NOₓ) ki kaafi miqdar paida karti hai.

Air pollution ke doosre natural sources yeh hain: samandar ki satah par algae, jo hydrogen sulphide (H₂S) gas chhorti hai; hawa se mitti ka kataao (wind erosion), jo PM laata hai; aur nam (humid) ilaqe jaise swamps (daldal), peat bogs ya kam gehri jheelein, jo methane (CH₄) paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ka lafz
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'peat-bags' aur 'little deep lakes' chhapa hai; matlab peat bogs (daldali zameen jahan paudon ka malba jama hota hai) aur kam gehri jheelein hain.

blocks.prompt: Air pollutants ke teen bare natural sources batayein aur mukhtasar wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation: Volcano gases, raakh aur dhool ki bari miqdar nikalte hain; aasmani bijli hawa ko itna garam karti hai ke nitrogen aur oxygen mil kar NOₓ banate hain; aur swamps jaise nam ilaqe paudon ke galne se methane chhorte hain. Dhool, pollens aur H₂S dene wali samandari algae mazeed misalein hain.

items: Natural: dhool, pollens, spores (PM); volcano (gases, PM); bijli (NOₓ); algae (H₂S); wind erosion (PM); swamps aur bogs (CH₄).
